name: Zepp
description: Read Zepp / Amazfit watch data: daily activity, workouts, sleep, heart rate and body composition
author: flock

mcp.setupInstructions: Add one account per person, using that person's Zepp app sign-in. Each account needs its own token cache path so tokens never cross between people.

setupSteps.title: Zepp sign-in
setupSteps.description: Enter the email and password used in the Zepp app.

setupSteps.title: Region
setupSteps.description: Two-letter country code of the Zepp account, e.g. IN or US.

setupSteps.title: Token cache
setupSteps.description: A file path unique to this person, e.g. ~/.zepp-mcp/<name>/token.json. Never reuse another account's path.

envVars.name: ZEPP_EMAIL
envVars.label: Zepp email
envVars.description: Email used to sign in to the Zepp app

envVars.name: ZEPP_PASSWORD
envVars.label: Zepp password
envVars.description: Password used to sign in to the Zepp app

envVars.name: ZEPP_COUNTRY
envVars.label: Country code
envVars.description: Two-letter region of the Zepp account (default US)

envVars.name: ZEPP_TOKEN_CACHE
envVars.label: Token cache path
envVars.description: Per-account token cache file; must differ for every account
